definitions.explanation: A friend who is a woman or girl. It means a friend, not a romantic partner; a girlfriend in the romantic sense is {彼女|かのじょ}.

examples.japanese: {女友達|おんなともだち}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip with my female friends.
He has a lot of female friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧じゃ⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女友達|おんなともだち}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧、⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦もらえなかった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I explained that she was just a friend, not my girlfriend, nobody believed me.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧: girlfriend (romantic partner). English "girlfriend" covers both; Japanese keeps them apart, so ⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女友達|おんなともだち} ("just a friend") is the usual way to make the difference clear.
- ⟦{男友達|おとこともだち}→男友達：32688_otokotomodachi⟧: male friend, the counterpart
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧: among women (⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧⟦{同士|どうし}→同士：03474_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧, friendship between women)

USAGE:
Women often say just ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧; {女友達|おんなともだち} is used when the gender matters, most often by or about men.
